betting_tiles.text: Get 50% back up to £50 with QuinnBet
betting_tiles.description: <View><RParagraph>18+ GambleAware. New UK Customers Only. Bet £10+ on any sportsbook markets at odds of evens (2.00) or greater. Get 50% back of your first day’s losses as a Free Bet up to £50, valid for 7 days.</RParagraph></View>
